'''R8-X6''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was part of the security forces of the [[Jedi Colony]] established on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. During the [[Invasion of Ossus]], it was destroyed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] forces who raided a Republic communications control bunker.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=heroic|Information Appropriation|Ossus}}</ref>
